description: This file defines a command class 'AddDataGroupCommand' within the OrangeHRM system. It provides functionality to add data groups, optionally for API access, including user prompts and database SQL generation.
external_methods: namespace OrangeHRM\DevTools\Command", // Namespace declaration, no method call here but indicates context

classes.name: AddDataGroupCommand
classes.description: Defines a Symfony console command to add data groups in OrangeHRM, including optional API permission configuration. It provides interactive prompts for input, handles SQL logging, and outputs sample SQL queries.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command, adding arguments and options for data group properties and API permissions.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the command with SymfonyStyle for input/output.

methods.name: interact
methods.description: Interactive method to gather and validate user input for data group creation, including API details if applicable.

methods.name: getModuleAutocompleteQuestion
methods.description: Creates an autocompleter-enabled question for selecting a module.

methods.name: notBlankValidation
methods.description: Validates that input strings are not blank.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the creation of the data group and API permission entities, outputs tables and SQL queries, optionally simulating insertions.

methods.name: printDataGroupTable
methods.description: Outputs a table summarizing the data group.

methods.name: printDataGroupSQL
methods.description: Outputs sample SQL insert statement for the data group.

methods.name: printApiPermissionTable
methods.description: Outputs a table with API permission entity info.

methods.name: printApiPermissionSQL
methods.description: Outputs SQL statements related to API permission configuration.

methods.name: printBlock
methods.description: Outputs a block of text as a visual block for SQL scripts.
